History:
54-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2020, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypertension, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 34 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 5.7 (high disease activity).
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
